title: SEKTION base cabinet for sink
description: SEKTION base cabinet for sink, white/Sinarp brown, 24x24x30" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with dark brown SINARP fronts with solid wood edging, you get a kitchen that is full of character and fine detail.
features: Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.

To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
